description: This file defines the FacebookLoginConfiguration class which configures Facebook authentication options within an OrchardCore module, including setting AppId, AppSecret, and callback paths, and handles related settings and services.

classes.name: FacebookLoginConfiguration
classes.description: Configures Facebook authentication options, manages Facebook settings, and handles login configuration within the OrchardCore module.

methods.name: Configure (AuthenticationOptions)
methods.description: Adds Facebook scheme to authentication options if settings are valid.

methods.name: Configure (string, FacebookOptions)
methods.description: Configures FacebookOptions with AppId, AppSecret, CallbackPath, and SaveTokens based on settings.

methods.name: Configure (FacebookOptions)
methods.description: Infrastructure method that should not be called.

methods.name: GetFacebookLoginSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and validates Facebook login settings.
